content:
The image shows a tomato leaf (underside) with multiple scattered dark lesions. Key observations:

- Multiple circular to slightly irregular dark brown/black spots across the leaf
- Spots appear small to medium sized, with darker centers (consistent with pycnidia)
- No pronounced concentric rings (ruling out Early Blight)
- No white fuzzy sporulation (ruling out Late Blight)
- No olive-green velvety mold on underside (ruling out Leaf Mold)
- No yellow halos prominent enough for Bacterial Speck
- Spots appear on the lower/older leaf, which is the typical progression pattern for Septoria

The pattern matches Septoria Leaf Blotch: small dark spots with dark pycnidia in centers, dark brown perimeter, no concentric rings, on lower leaves.
